statements.text: The awards to Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and xAI – each with a $200M ceiling – will enable the Department to leverage the technology and talent of U.S. frontier AI companies to develop agentic AI workflows across a variety of mission areas.
statements.context: Today, the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office (CDAO) announced contract awards to leading U.S. frontier AI companies to accelerate Department of Defense (DoD) adoption of advanced AI capabilities to address critical national security challenges. Frontier AI companies lead development of the most advanced AI models and technologies, conduct insightful research into the use of frontier AI, and pioneer efforts to address both the potential benefits and risks of frontier AI technologies. The awards to Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and xAI – each with a $200M ceiling – will enable the Department to leverage the technology and talent of U.S. frontier AI companies to develop agentic AI workflows across a variety of mission areas.

statements.text: The realignment of the CDAO to USD(R&E) will accelerate Department-wide AI transformation. The Department of Defense (DoD) seeks to become an AI-first enterprise, one that rapidly adopts cutting-edge commercial AI technologies, exploits data at scale to generate operational advantage, and leads the discovery of new ways to fight and win.
statements.context: Aug. 20, 2025 # CDAO Re-alignment to USD(R&E) Accelerates AI Transformation at DoD Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office Arlington, VA – On August 14, 2025, the Deputy Secretary of Defense directed that the Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Officer (CDAO) be realigned under the Office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Research and Engineering (USD(R&E)), effective immediately. The realignment of the CDAO to USD(R&E) will accelerate Department-wide AI transformation. The Department of Defense (DoD) seeks to become an AI-first enterprise, one that rapidly adopts cutting-edge commercial AI technologies, exploits data at scale to generate operational advantage, and leads the discovery of new ways to fight and win.

statements.text: The GenAI Toolkit operationalizes the memo through specific assessments and tools tailored to enable GenAI project leaders to ensure responsible and safe design, development, deployment, and use of this new technology.
statements.context: By Chief Digital and Artificial Intelligence Office The CDAO has publicly launched the Generative AI version of the RAI Toolkit, termed the “GenAI Toolkit,” in support of the Department’s implementation of its Guidelines & Guardrails for Governance of Generative AI Memorandum. The Guidelines & Guardrails provided guidance to DoD Components for proactively addressing risks associated with GenAI capabilities. The GenAI Toolkit operationalizes the memo through specific assessments and tools tailored to enable GenAI project leaders to ensure responsible and safe design, development, deployment, and use of this new technology.
